soldier: Head pale yellowish brown and covered with short pubescence, mandibles brownish yellow, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head slightly square, the sides nearly parallel, slightly broader at the middle, the anterior margin slightly concave and the posterior margin nearly straight; labrum semicircular; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth behind the apical third, and two minute teeth above the base of each mandible; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.34 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, its posterior margin slightly projecting.
